info.title: API.SH: H-E-B
info.description: The H-E-B API from API.SH: public H-E-B data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Browse one H-E-B category for one store, with its name, breadcrumbs and the same product fields, filters and sorts as search. 60 products a page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/heb-category

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: The number at the end of a category link, e.g. 490016, or the link.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filters as id:value pairs from a search's `filters`, comma-separated, e.g. brand:H-E-B or savings:coupon.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: H-E-B store number the prices and stock are for (default 92; see /heb/v1/stores).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search H-E-B products for one store with the shop's filters and sorts. Each product: id, SKU, name, brand, own-brand flag, link, image, price and the online and curbside prices, size, stock, aisle, category, ad and coupon flags, new-item, SNAP and priced-by-weight flags, description, plus `raw`. Also returns the filter options with counts and the matching categories. 60 products a page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/heb-search

get.description:
H-E-B stores near an address or ZIP code: store number, name, address, phone, coordinates, distance in miles, format, pharmacy flag, opening hours, fulfillment options and departments with their phones and hours, plus `raw`. Five stores a page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/heb-stores

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
